reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 against the Horizon Nexus (Audit) Pty Ltd independent auditor's report on the AUDF Reserves Report as at 31 May 2026 11:59pm AEST. Management asserts AUD 5,136,311.71 of AUDF in circulation across Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Avalanche and Redbelly against an equal AUD cash balance in a single Australian-dollar reserve bank account; Horizon Nexus opines that the cash balance is prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the stated accounting policies (signed Melbourne 1 June 2026). Notes state AUD reserves are owned/managed by Forte Securities Australia Pty Ltd, segregated from operational funds, and unencumbered. No other reserve asset classes are disclosed. Bank identity remains undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Horizon Nexus independent audit of the AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance as of 2026-05-31
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset class is identified as an AUD bank-account cash balance. The bank identity, provider concentration, and account terms remain undisclosed custody details.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Management and Horizon Nexus describe one segregated, unencumbered AUDF reserve bank account in Australia but do not name the bank, disclose provider allocations, establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness or trust status for token holders, or state anti-rehypothecation / successor-custody terms. Binding terms deny holders a security interest or trust/fiduciary claim on reserves.
